name: managing-estate-and-gift-tax
description: Evaluates federal estate, gift and generation-skipping transfer (GST) tax planning and compliance for U.S. citizens and residents: the $15,000,000 basic exclusion for 2026 under Pub. L. 119-21 (indexed, no sunset), the $19,000 annual exclusion, anti-clawback, portability and DSUE (last deceased spouse, Rev. Proc. 2022-32 late election), GST exemption allocation and automatic allocation elections, Crummey withdrawal rights, split gifts, adequate disclosure of gifts, Form 706 and Form 709 deadlines with the IRC 7503 roll, alternate valuation, 6166 and 6161 payment relief, retained-interest inclusion under 2036, and transfer-tax treatment of the fair market value of a transferred interest (2031, 2512, Chapter 14, valuation understatement penalties). Covers no step-up for grantor trust assets (Rev. Rul. 2023-2), Connelly redemption and life insurance, gifts of closely held stock and generational transfers. Routes valuation models, instrument drafting, state law and IRS disputes. Drafts for qualified review.
